  - 0 status:error logs in window; host CPU flat (max 18.6%); traffic normal (23,161 hits/45min, max 536/10s)

Trace IDs: n/a — no sample trace captured (dd_search.py logs returned 0 error-level hits to sample from)
Likely cause: unidentified — REFUTED ki-2026-07-06-tables-fields-redis-circuitbreaker-p95-latency (3rd refutation): its Redis-circuit-breaker evidence_query returned 0 hits, the app-update-push disqualifier returned 0 hits, broader *Redis* sweep 0 hits, and runtime-core-api's RTC p95 monitors did not co-fire this time. None of the 3 previously-documented mechanisms for this monitor pair reproduced.
Suggested next action: file defect / flag to Admin team for APM trace-level investigation (dd_search.py has no trace-level tooling) — monitor for recurrence with the same 'no mechanism' shape
